summary: rwc-client preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated sibling payload
details: The package advertises itself as a Vue-based chat UI, but its declared `preinstall` script runs `node setup.mjs`, which downloads the Bun runtime archive from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases at install time, extracts it to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it against a bundled sibling file `math_init.js` via `execFileSync`. `math_init.js` is a 727 KB Bun-compiled JavaScript file (header `// @bun @bun-cjs`) with string-array + array-shift decoder obfuscation (`WV8StW`), mangled identifiers, and a large constant table; its name and contents bear no relation to a chat UI. Fetching a second language runtime during install specifically to execute an obfuscated sibling file that the package's declared purpose does not require is the alternate-runtime dropper pattern: the payload evades Node-based scanners and runs under Bun on the installer's machine. static analysis of the umd/common webpack bundles also matched network+command patterns (`ping`, HTTP `GET`) inside dist/lib/richWebChat.*.14.js.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
